item.title: Mallrat Talks ‘World Building,’ North America Tour and New Music
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to this week's music update. We're shining the spotlight on Australian artist Mallrat, who's been making waves with her latest project, "Light Hit My Face Like A Straight Right".
[Soft music transitions in]
Host: Released in 2025, this collection is a unique blend of the future and nostalgia, with Mallrat, aka Grace Shaw, showcasing her impressive vocals and maturing songwriting skills. The album features collaborations with notable artists like Cub Sport's Tim Nelson and U.S. producer Buddy Ross.
[Music transitions to a clip from Mallrat's album]
Host: Shaw's production on the album earned her Producer of the Year at the 2026 Queensland Music Awards, and she was also nominated for Album of the Year, Best Solo Artist, and Best Pop Release at the ARIA Awards.
[Music transitions back to the host]
Host: Mallrat's world is a parallel universe, where magic appears through strange little portals. Her album artwork features her climbing on a Hills Hoist clothesline, which is more than just an Australian icon - it's a portal to her magical world.
[Music transitions to a clip from Mallrat's live performance at Vivid Sydney]
Host: Mallrat recently performed at Vivid Sydney, where she presented her unique sound to a live audience. With a three-piece lineup, including a live drummer and keyboardist, she delivered an energetic set that had the crowd captivated.
[Music transitions back to the host]
Host: If you're in the U.S. or Canada, you can catch Mallrat live later this year, starting June 13 in New York City. She'll be supporting Swedish artist Tove Lo on tour, with dates running until October 1 in Mexico City.
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's all for this week's music update. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you next time!
